evals.prompt: Robloxでオープンワールドのアクションゲームを作ってる。プレイヤーはR15で、既定の Animate スクリプトのまま。坂を登るときに足が地面にめり込んで、階段では片足が宙に浮くのが気になる。あと走りながら曲がるときに体が全然傾かなくて棒立ちに見える。アニメーションのアップロードはしたくないので、LocalScript で足を地面に合わせて、旋回で体を内側に傾けるようにしてほしい。リグの計測値は rig-r15.json にある。NPC にも同じ見た目にしたい。オフラインで検証できるテストも付けて。
evals.expected_output: Client-side Luau pose layer (Transform written in PreSimulation, Motor6D+AnimationConstraint support) with per-foot ground raycasts started above the step, pelvis drop + two-bone IK, velocity-based bank with clamps/springs pivoting on the planted foot, no physics changes, NPC/remote support, rate-limited corrections; a Lune test using rig-r15.json that runs and passes; a Studio verification procedure with numbers to check.
assertions: All Luau files compile
The run's own offline tests run under Lune and pass
Finds AnimationConstraint joints too (Server Authority avatars have no Motor6D)
Joint Transforms are written from PreSimulation/Stepped, never from RenderStepped/PreRender
Never writes physics (root CFrame/velocity, HipHeight, Anchored, WalkSpeed)
Casts rays for the ground (per foot or per body)
Lean is computed from the body's velocity (works for NPCs without input)
Report gives a Studio verification procedure with numeric pass criteria
Lean follows the velocity direction (camera turns / shift-lock do not tilt the body)
Stairs behaviour is measured with a moving simulation and reported honestly

evals.prompt: R15の剣の3連撃アニメーションを作って。1撃目は右上からの袈裟斬り、2撃目は横薙ぎ、3撃目は振りかぶって叩きつけ。予備動作・振り・フォロースルーをちゃんと入れて重さが出るように、ヒットした瞬間に一瞬止めたい（ヒットストップ）。既定の Animate とは共存させる。アップロードは後でやるので、まずはコード（Luau）で動くものと、各関節の角度とタイミングの仕様を出して。リグは rig-r15.json。
evals.expected_output: A spec per strike (anticipation/strike/follow-through timings, joint angles with the R15 sign conventions stated), Luau that renders the combo over Animate (Transform in PreSimulation or a KeyframeSequence with an Action+ priority) with feet kept planted, hit-stop that freezes only the pose clock (not physics/input), combo chaining without pops, notes that runtime KeyframeSequence registration is Studio-only, an offline test and a Studio verification procedure.
assertions: All Luau files compile
The run's own offline tests run under Lune and pass
Finds AnimationConstraint joints too (Server Authority avatars have no Motor6D)
SPEC covers anticipation / strike / follow-through for the strikes
SPEC states the joint sign conventions
Coexists with Animate: Action+ priority track or Transform written after the Animator (PreSimulation)
Transform writes (if any) are not in RenderStepped/PreRender
Hit-stop implemented
Hit-stop / combo never writes physics (root CFrame/velocity, Anchored, WalkSpeed)
If KeyframeSequences are registered at runtime, the report says it is Studio-only
Joint sign conventions are verified against the rig, not assumed
Other players / NPCs see the combo (replication path implemented)

evals.prompt: mini-game フォルダのゲームで、着地のアニメがほとんど効いてない気がするし、待機の呼吸もロボットっぽい。改善して、最終的に places/Game.rbxlx（正本）に取り込める状態にしてほしい。NOTES.md も読んで。
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that the existing Transform writes happen in RenderStepped (ignored) and moves them to PreSimulation with base restore; improves landing (impact-scaled knee absorption, both feet planted, anticipation before contact) and idle (asymmetric weight shift + breathing, non-repeating); keeps the teammate's uncommitted AnimConfig edit; works on a copy of the Studio-saved Place, merges only the changed scripts with a byte-level/reversibility check and backup instead of rebuilding from Rojo; does not publish; gives a Studio verification procedure.
assertions: All Luau files compile
The run's own offline tests run under Lune and pass
Finds AnimationConstraint joints too (Server Authority avatars have no Motor6D)
Teammate's uncommitted AnimConfig edit (IDLE_BREATH_SECONDS = 2.6) is preserved
Nothing committed in the user's repository
Report diagnoses that RenderStepped Transform writes are not rendered
New code writes Transforms from PreSimulation/Stepped
A Place carrying the improved scripts exists (canonical updated, or canonical + layer candidate)
That Place still contains the hand-placed map (not rebuilt from src)
Map parts in that Place are byte-identical to the original
Report proves the Place change (backup + hash/diff/reversal check)
Report gives a Studio verification procedure
Landing / idle also drawn on other players' bodies
Canonical Place is left intact until the user's Studio check (candidate + apply/revert)
